context: A boss reviews quarterly metrics with his manager
purpose: Teach: 指数/媒体/正規/相対/保持/バックナンバー/チャート/マクロ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の売上チャートを見ると、主要指数が前期比で明らかに落ち込んでいるな。
lines.en: Looking at this quarter's sales chart, the main index has clearly dropped compared to last quarter.
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening, slightly stern and analytical tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、特に広告媒体への支出が膨らんだ割に、効果は弱かったように思います。
lines.en: Yes, despite the swollen spending on advertising media, the effect seems to have been weak.
lines.style: Polite manager replying with measured, formal business Japanese.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 正規の販売ルートと外注ルートの相対的な伸び率はどうなっている?
lines.en: How do the relative growth rates of our regular sales channels and outsourced channels compare?
lines.style: Direct probing question, expecting a concrete numerical answer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 正規ルートは現状保持といったところですが、外注側はおよそ三割減でして、厳しい数字です。
lines.en: The regular route is holding steady, but the outsourced side is down roughly thirty percent, which is harsh.
lines.style: Cautious, slightly apologetic delivery softening bad news.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去のバックナンバーの報告書も取り出して、傾向を改めて確認してくれ。
lines.en: Pull out the back numbers of the past reports too, and re-check the overall trend.
lines.style: Issuing a clear, concise instruction with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。三年分を並べて、適宜要点を抜粋した資料をご用意いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare materials covering three years, with key points appropriately extracted.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, dutiful subordinate confirming the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それと、市場全体のマクロな動きが分かる指数もあれば一緒に添えてくれ。
lines.en: Also, if there are indices that show overall macro market movements, attach those as well.
lines.style: Adding follow-up requirement, deliberate and forward-looking tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。来週の懇談会までに、見やすいチャート形式でまとめてご提出いたします。
lines.en: Certainly. I will compile it in an easy-to-read chart format before next week's meeting.
lines.style: Formal closing commitment with humble keigo register.
